results.description:
Build an aquarium with the fish, scenery and water conditions you choose. Explore coral reefs, coastal rockpools, Monterey-inspired kelp forests, seagrass lagoons, reef channels, mangrove creeks, mountain streams and planted freshwater tanks.

Keep Duo Aquarium open on any supported iPhone for an aquarium on your desk or nightstand. Show a clock and local weather, or choose Pure focus to hide all text for an uninterrupted view.

225 RESIDENT CHOICES
Choose from 199 fish varieties and 26 invertebrates, including six freshwater shrimp and snails. Add Peruvian red-spotted green discus in six descriptive colour and pattern options, marbled hatchetfish, elephantnose fish, puffers, whiptails, longhorn cowfish and more. Familiar choices include common and fantail goldfish, tiger oscars, tetras, cichlids, damsels, gobies and wrasses. Each of the 12 starter habitats includes 32–40 residents, with shoals, roaming fish and bottom dwellers suited to the scene. Search for a species or family, add residents individually, or use the habitat's suggested population.

BUILD AND SAVE YOUR OWN TANKS
Add plants, kelp, seaweed, corals, anemones, rocks, wood and shells. Adjust each object's position, depth, size and rotation. Save named aquariums and return to your custom designs. Replace the residents while keeping your scenery, water and lighting, with an option to save a copy first. Your changes are remembered as you move between habitats.

CONTROL THE WATER AND LIGHT
Adjust water clarity, current, brightness and rippling light. Choose daybreak, daylight, moonlight or reef-blue lighting, or follow the time of day. Change how far fish roam and how closely schooling fish stay together. Fish can swim beyond the screen and return, with more space between larger residents. Feed a small batch of food, stop feeding, or pause the tank.

YOUR MUSIC
Choose from six included ambient tracks, play a favourite, or shuffle the collection. You can also connect Apple Music to browse your library, find songs and playlists, and control playback. Apple Music access needs permission; catalog streaming requires an Apple Music subscription. The included tracks work offline without an account. Water sound is separately optional.

CHOOSE WHAT APPEARS
Focus mode hides the clock, weather, app name, habitat label and other overlays. Or choose a clock font, format and position, with an optional date. Add local weather from Apple Weather with System, Celsius or Fahrenheit units, and choose whether to show conditions, daily high/low, rain chance or wind. Weather needs optional location permission and an internet connection to update.

MADE FOR iPhone Duo
Fold part-way to enter Desk view automatically, with the aquarium and clock above the hinge and controls below. Open flat to return to the aquarium. Portrait and landscape layouts also work on other iPhones and iPad. Native fold features require iOS 27.1 or later.

SHARE YOUR AQUARIUM
Send a tank code or link so a friend can visit. Or place two nearby devices side by side and let one tank stretch across both screens. Hosting a visit requires iCloud; nearby sharing uses Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. Your own tank remains saved while you visit another.

Use widgets to see your tank, or feed through Siri and Shortcuts. No ads or tracking. No account is needed for the aquarium or included music.
results.releaseNotes:
• 53 more fish options, bringing the catalogue to 225 resident choices: 199 fish varieties and 26 invertebrates.
• Peruvian red-spotted green discus in six descriptive colour and pattern options, plus hatchetfish, elephantnose fish, puffers, whiptails, cowfish and familiar aquarium favourites.
• Monterey-inspired kelp scenery, taller swaying giant kelp, revised coastal props and refined ground creatures.
• More room for fish to swim offscreen and return, with smoother turns and less crowding.
• Fuller starter habitats with 32–40 residents, plus a residents-only update that keeps your scenery and can save a backup first.
• Six included ambient music tracks with track selection and shuffle.
• Optional Apple Music library, song and playlist playback. Catalog streaming requires an Apple Music subscription.
• Optional Apple Weather, temperature units and condition, high/low, rain and wind display choices.
• Refined bottom-dweller movement and individual school timing, improved Apple Music error handling, and clearer Apple Weather attribution.
• Focus mode, saved tanks and custom water, lighting and scenery controls across 12 habitats.

NEW: NATIVE iPhone Duo SUPPORT

• Fold iPhone Duo into a tabletop position to enter Desk view automatically.
• Watch the aquarium and clock above the hinge, with feeding, lighting and aquarium controls below.
• Open flat to return to the full tank after entering Desk view by folding.
• Layouts adapt to the inner and outer displays and keep controls clear of the fold.

Your saved fish, scenery and settings stay with you.
results.description:
A living aquarium that changes with iPhone Duo. Fold it part-way for your desk. Open it flat to explore the tank. Choose the fish, plant a freshwater scene or build a reef, and share the view with someone else.

DESIGNED FOR iPhone Duo
• Fold part-way into a tabletop position to enter Desk view automatically. The aquarium and clock stay above the hinge, with feeding, lighting and aquarium controls below.
• Open the device flat to return from automatic Desk view to the full aquarium.
• The native layout responds to the hinge and keeps controls clear of the fold.
• On other iPhones, iPad and Mac, enjoy the aquarium and Desk view in their own screen layouts.

BUILD YOUR AQUARIUM
• Choose freshwater and reef fish, from shoaling tetras and angelfish to clownfish, tangs and gobies.
• Add plants, corals, anemones, rocks and wood. Place coral on live rock and adjust your scenery.
• Moving water, rippling light and real 3D scanned coral give the tank depth.
• Feed your fish and watch them gather. Tap a resident or piece of scenery to identify it.
• Take a clean picture of your tank with the controls hidden.

A CLOCK BESIDE THE WATER
• Desk view combines your aquarium with a clock, date and optional local weather.
• Choose the clock's position, font and format, or show just the tank.
• Switch between daybreak, daylight, moonlight and reef-blue lighting, with a daily light cycle and an evening dim.
• Play optional calm music and water sound, or keep it silent.

SHARE YOUR TANK
• Let a friend visit using your tank code or link. They see your fish, scenery and lighting, while their own tank stays saved.
• Place two nearby devices side by side and stretch one tank across them. Fish swim between the screens and either device can feed them.
• Nearby sharing uses Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. Visiting a shared tank uses the internet; hosting requires iCloud.

SMALL DAILY DETAILS
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your tank and last feeding.
• Set an optional daily feeding reminder, or feed through Siri and Shortcuts.
• Keep the tank in a window or full screen on Mac.

Your tank is saved on your device. No ads or tracking. Sharing stays off until you enable it, and you can stop it at any time.

iPhone Duo fold features require iOS 27.1 or later. iPhone, iPad and Mac are trademarks of Apple Inc. iPhone Duo is a trademark of Apple Inc.
